title: Southern Ring Nebula (NIRCam and MIRI Images Side by Side)
object: Southern Ring Nebula (NGC 3132), a planetary nebula
credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI, and the Webb ERO Production Team
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESA/Webb image use policy, https://esawebb.org/copyright/); credit must be shown unaltered
observatory_instrument: James Webb Space Telescope, NIRCam (left) and MIRI (right)
band: Left: near-infrared (NIRCam); right: mid-infrared (MIRI). Filters are not named on the source page
image_kind: two processed composites side by side, colours assigned per instrument (NIRCam: inner gas blue, outer orange; MIRI: inner red, outer blue)
processing_notes: Published collage; no further processing by this project.
derivative_operations: none: the file is used exactly as downloaded; at run time it is decoded and uploaded to the GPU as RGBA8 with mipmaps for display only
intended_use: Observation view reference panel; displayed unmodified with its credit line beside it, compared side by side with the STELLARIS procedural scene, which is labelled a conceptual visualization and not a reconstruction.
